In some blast loading situations, negative blast wave parameters (Figure 2-8 (+)) are needed to predict the loading-time function of the blast wave acting on a structure. This is particularly true in flexible type protective structures (usually steel-frame structures)where the overall motion of the structure will be affected by the phasing of the blast loads acting on the various structure surfaces. The effects of the negative phase parameters are usually not important for the design of the more rigid type structures (reinforced concrete).
